exercise.instruction: Write a class Animal with a constructor(name) that stores this.name, and a speak() method returning this.name + " makes a sound". Then create a class Dog that extends Animal and overrides speak() to return this.name + " barks". Instantiate a Dog with the name "Rex" and set output.textContent to the result of dog.speak(). Expected: Rex barks.
hints: Hint 1: class Dog extends Animal { constructor(name) { super(name); } speak() { return this.name + " barks"; } }

quiz.question: What does the constructor method do?
options: Runs when a new instance is created with new
Runs every time a method is called

quiz.question: Why must a subclass call super()?
options: To run the parent constructor and set up this before using it
